$comment: Structure placements (docs/WORLD_GENERATION.md §2, docs/STRUCTURES.md §8, ADR 0043): committed structures (shared/structures) the terrain generator stands on its ground. One candidate per `grid` cell, at a hashed point in it, kept by the density (inside the grove noise, `groves.outside` of it elsewhere), scaled by the height (`rise`: `low` at height[0], 1 from `full` up), and only where the ground at the anchor is one of `on`, its height (m above sea level) inside `height`, its slope at most `maxSlopeDeg` and, with footprint "on", every column under the structure is one of `on` too; of two candidates whose boxes come within `spacing` blocks the one with the lower priority hash is dropped. Each is turned by one of `rotate` and picked from `structures` by weight. `variants` swap blocks of a placed structure by the anchor's height (m above sea level): none at height[0], every one from height[1], a share in between (owner, 2026-10-21: snowy leaves on the pines high up). All decided from the world seed and positions, so chunks agree in any order. Prototype content. Run `node shared/worldgen/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails on stale output.
